pages.title: Palorchestes
pages.text: The Palorchestes ($(o)Palorchestes azael$()) is an extinct marsupial that lived in Australia during the Pleistocene.$(br2)Despite its tapir-like build, it was not a tapir at all, but a relative of wombats and Diprotodon. It was first thought to be a giant kangaroo, hence its name, meaning "ancient leaper".$(br2)Palorchestes was a herbivore with powerful forelimbs armed with long claws, likely used to strip or pull down vegetation.
